baseline_scope: Current working tree, including uncommitted implementation; not a released/tagged baseline.

tasks.title: Freeze and verify the implementation baseline
tasks.context: Capture the current implementation without accidentally omitting untracked specialists or including secrets.
acceptance_criteria: Review all tracked/untracked changes and preserve unrelated user work.
Run locked dependency installation, full pytest and full lint; record versions and results.
With explicit approval, commit the agreed baseline and record its commit/tag in baseline.md; exclude credentials, outputs and private keys.
tasks.test_requirements: Full unit suite, clean lint, secret scan and fresh-checkout reproduction.

tasks.title: Connect research stages to durable provider-managed workflows
tasks.context: Close the gap between reusable research components and durable provider-managed DAG execution; no separately hosted always-running backend API is required.
acceptance_criteria: A worker claims a queued case and injects all four enabled specialists using approved configuration.
Identity ambiguity stops fan-out; successful branch outputs survive process restart.
Use one execution owner per run and reconcile native workflow execution with application stage persistence without duplicate claims.
Verify the selected provider's approved source-access capabilities; failed, partial or unavailable stages remain visible.
Support a single-organization, single-worker installation first; use expiring claims and ownership tokens to reject stale-worker writes and recover interrupted cases.
Persist branch results idempotently; replay and accidental competing workers must not duplicate evidence, finalize twice or lose completed work.

Execute Python/SQL stages in the selected provider's managed runtime independently of the Streamlit session and developer laptop; local workers are optional development tools, not required deployment topology.
tasks.test_requirements: Restart, competing worker, duplicate claim, timeout and partial-source integration tests.

tasks.title: Persist normalized evidence and add a cached research provider
tasks.context: RAW/OPS persistence exists; normalized reusable research storage is still missing.
acceptance_criteria: Add reviewed migrations for normalized records with source/version/raw lineage and explicit publication/retrieval dates.
Implement cached providers using the existing provider contracts and immutable snapshots.
Replay a stored case without source HTTP requests; keep stale/partial/blocked scope explicit.
Failed normalization does not release partial or unverified records.
tasks.test_requirements: Migration checksums, cache/replay equivalence, stale data and interrupted-write tests.

tasks.title: Implement trusted application identity and tenant authorization
tasks.context: Role-shaped context objects are not authentication or verified tenant membership.
acceptance_criteria: Choose and document an approved identity provider and server-side tenant membership source.
Derive user, role and tenant from verified credentials, never editable request fields.
Authorize case/evidence reads and commands; reject cross-tenant and viewer writes.
Audit authorization failures without exposing keys, raw personal data or credentials.
tasks.test_requirements: Forged token, cross-tenant ID, role escalation, revoked membership and service-identity tests.

tasks.title: Implement durable intake and clarification services
tasks.context: Name discovery works but durable authorized intake and confirmation services are incomplete; HTTP endpoints are an optional transport, not a mandatory backend deployment.
acceptance_criteria: Persist authenticated intake with idempotency and bounded inputs.
Return unresolved candidates; require an explicit confirmed identifier before research.
Clarification/resubmission creates a linked new version without overwriting history.
Expose authorized case and stage status queries to Streamlit through application services; optional HTTP endpoints must retain the same contracts and authorization.
tasks.test_requirements: Duplicate submission, same-name ambiguity, stale confirmation, invalid inputs and restart tests.

tasks.title: Implement scoped cross-registry identifier mapping
tasks.context: GLEIF-to-national-register linkage must not be confirmed by name or country alone.
acceptance_criteria: Extract issuing-authority and registration identifiers with source locators.
Version verified mappings between GLEIF authorities and national registry scopes.
Confirm Norway linkage only through supported scoped identifiers and name checks.
Unknown mappings remain pending; preserve identifier zeros and jurisdiction subdivisions.
tasks.test_requirements: Same-name entities, authority mismatch, leading zeros, changed names and ambiguous mapping tests.

tasks.title: Evaluate multilingual names and alias query planning
tasks.context: Current matching preserves Unicode but does not implement calibrated transliteration or translation.
acceptance_criteria: Define language/transliteration policy with original names retained.
Bound alias query counts; never silently rewrite unsafe provider syntax.
Evaluate false positives/negatives on labeled multilingual and same-name cases.
No name-only match becomes authoritative identity confirmation.
tasks.test_requirements: Multiscript, short alias, legal-suffix, transliteration collision and query-budget tests.

tasks.title: Add bounded source retries and interrupted-run recovery
tasks.context: Failures are isolated but automatic backoff and reconciliation are missing.
acceptance_criteria: Honor Retry-After with bounded attempts, jitter, deadlines and per-source budgets.
Distinguish fetch retry from unknown write outcome; reconcile stored evidence before rewriting.
Recover abandoned runs and incomplete chunks without claiming clean coverage.
Retain sanitized error categories and operational diagnostics.
tasks.test_requirements: 429, timeout, process kill, partial chunks, unknown commit and exhausted-budget tests.

tasks.title: Implement source snapshot refresh and publication freshness
tasks.context: Retrieval freshness alone does not establish freshness of source publication.
acceptance_criteria: Record source publication/version metadata where available and unknown where absent.
Use source-specific refresh policies with conditional requests where supported.
Generate snapshot diffs without treating removed records as acquittal or dismissal.
Verify schedules remain inactive until budget/access approval.
Use separate shared-source refresh and per-case research workflows; publish immutable snapshot references and reuse them across cases instead of downloading global lists for every case.
tasks.test_requirements: Unchanged snapshot, stale publication, missing timestamp, removal and malformed-update tests.

tasks.title: Implement the next official national registry adapter
tasks.context: Global company identity coverage currently relies mainly on GLEIF and Norway.
acceptance_criteria: Select one jurisdiction explicitly after official access, rights and coverage research.
Create a separate adapter with scoped identifiers, pagination and typed evidence.
Record credential/access blockers rather than enabling unsupported scraping.
Verify a real retrieval and Snowflake readback; create separate follow-up issues per additional jurisdiction.
tasks.test_requirements: Fixtures, schema drift, access errors, identifiers and one approved live integration run.

tasks.title: Extract authoritative sanctions identifiers with locators
tasks.context: Current adapters usually yield name-only candidates; supported identifier fields are unpopulated.
acceptance_criteria: Extract only identifiers explicitly supplied by each authority with type/scope and source locators.
Keep list record IDs distinct from company registration IDs or LEIs.
Add separately scoped non-SDN coverage only after its source contract is documented.
Name-only and ambiguous identifiers remain review-required.
tasks.test_requirements: Real format fixtures, identifier mismatch, wrong scope, aliases and live snapshot regression tests.

tasks.title: Implement bounded related-party sanctions evaluation
tasks.context: Direct organization matching does not cover ownership/control rules or directors.
acceptance_criteria: Document reviewed jurisdiction-specific ownership/control rules and authoritative inputs.
Resolve related subjects independently with bounded traversal and cycle handling.
Do not infer percentage ownership from GLEIF consolidation or board membership.
Expose rule version, evidence, uncertainty and review requirements; no automatic legal verdict.
tasks.test_requirements: Cycles, incomplete ownership, similarly named directors, threshold boundaries and conflicting evidence tests.

tasks.title: Resolve related organizations and role holders independently
tasks.context: Current parent and role records do not uniquely resolve people or related organizations.
acceptance_criteria: Introduce explicit related-party candidate/decision contracts with separate evidence.
Keep accounting consolidation, shareholding, control and appointments distinct.
Add bounded traversal with independent identities and stable cross-snapshot role references.
Do not expose raw birth dates/national identifiers by default.
tasks.test_requirements: Person-name collision, deregistered roles, organization holders, cycles and raw-privacy tests.

tasks.title: Retrieve permitted primary notices and verify procedural roles
tasks.context: Official feed metadata is not sufficient to determine event party roles or outcomes.
acceptance_criteria: Fetch only approved official documents under recorded usage/access rights and size limits.
Preserve party roles, procedural state, finality, dismissals, appeals and eligibility dates separately.
Link every interpretation to a cited span and source version.
Court access remains blocked without real permission; headlines cannot establish guilt.
tasks.test_requirements: Petition/order/dismissal, claimant/defendant, appeal, expired eligibility and missing-span tests.

tasks.title: Document news rights and extend approved newsroom coverage
tasks.context: GDELT provides bounded discovery, not licensed full text or verified publisher trust.
acceptance_criteria: Record permitted storage/display/full-text rights for the selected production provider.
Add independently registered approved official newsroom adapters.
Version publisher policies without inheriting trust from a discovery provider.
Retain metadata-only mode when content rights are absent; bound queries and cost.
tasks.test_requirements: Rights-denied, rate-limit, publisher mismatch, language metadata and official-feed schema tests.

tasks.title: Implement event clustering and syndication-aware comparisons
tasks.context: Exact response/title duplicate hints do not fully resolve repeated reports of one event.
acceptance_criteria: Cluster only supported same-party events using source locators and documented rules.
Distinguish independent evidence from syndicated copies and repeated reporting.
Preserve all original findings and uncertain clusters for review.
Repeated articles cannot multiply evidence confidence or future score contributions.
tasks.test_requirements: Same-title unrelated events, syndicated stories, differing parties and contradictory report tests.

tasks.title: Implement corrections and immutable case-version comparison
tasks.context: Current snapshots do not reconcile updates, dismissals and corrections across case versions.
acceptance_criteria: Link later corrections/appeals to earlier events without deleting original evidence.
Create immutable new case/assessment versions with change explanations.
Preserve prior reviewer decisions against their original snapshot hashes.
Do not interpret source disappearance as a resolved legal outcome.
tasks.test_requirements: Correction, appeal, dismissal, removed source and historical decision replay tests.

tasks.title: Implement evidence-backed claim review and eligibility
tasks.context: Structural validation exists but never establishes claim truth or scoring eligibility.
acceptance_criteria: Independently resolve stored observation/hash/locator references for reviewed claims.
Require grounded spans, party-role attribution and source-specific procedural interpretation.
Represent human/model review separately from structural checks; model output cannot self-approve.
Only explicitly approved claim types become eligible; missing/conflicting evidence abstains.
tasks.test_requirements: Forged evidence, unsupported claim, missing citation, prompt injection and unresolved identity tests.

tasks.title: Create labeled identity/event evaluation and release gates
tasks.context: Unit tests alone do not calibrate identity matching or adverse attribution quality.
acceptance_criteria: Create rights-safe labeled cases across jurisdictions/languages and same-name entities.
Measure attribution errors, missed relevance, unsupported conclusions and duplicate inflation.
Set reviewed acceptance thresholds and retain expected abstentions.
Run deterministic regression gates in CI and record provider/model versions.
tasks.test_requirements: Separate training/development from evaluation examples; include adversarial and outage cases.

tasks.title: Implement reviewed versioned scoring and routing policies
tasks.context: Assessments currently and intentionally have no risk score.
acceptance_criteria: Add a standalone policy loader/engine using approved eligible findings only.
Separate risk dimensions, evidence confidence and coverage; missing data never means low risk.
Persist policy/version/contributions and deterministic routing explanations.
Deduplicate event contributions; unconfigured or insufficient evidence remains unscored.
tasks.test_requirements: Policy boundaries, duplicate events, dismissals, missing coverage and replay reproducibility tests.

tasks.title: Implement provider-portable review persistence and versioned snapshots
tasks.context: The current transactional review adapter is SQLite development storage.
acceptance_criteria: Implement ReviewStore through the selected provider adapter with reviewed permissions and atomic/version-safe commands; preserve Snowflake as one implementation, not a mandatory dependency.
Preserve request idempotency, snapshot immutability, evidence references and supervisor reopen.
Support new research versions while retaining historical decisions.
Do not grant service owners blanket reviewer authority or describe the audit as tamper-proof without controls.
tasks.test_requirements: Concurrency, duplicate request, stale snapshot, unauthorized write and durable readback tests.

tasks.title: Expose authenticated review commands and operational actions
tasks.context: ReviewService is not an authenticated API or notification/business-action system.
acceptance_criteria: Expose authorized review/history/request-details/reject/reopen endpoints using trusted actor context.
Add separately specified approval/monitoring commands with reviewer permissions and rationale.
Queue notifications/actions through an idempotent outbox rather than executing before decision commit.
Reject client-supplied tenants, roles and forged case snapshots.
tasks.test_requirements: Viewer, cross-tenant, double-click, stale version, failed notification and supervisor tests.

tasks.title: Integrate governed model extraction as reviewable candidates
tasks.context: Governed extraction is a replaceable model-provider integration; Cortex is an optional provider implementation, not a required product runtime.
acceptance_criteria: Verify approved account capability, model allowlist, residency and inference budget before calls.
Use permitted excerpts with structured output, citations, model/prompt versions and limits.
Treat document text as untrusted data; extracted candidates pass the normal validation path.
Model failures leave readable gaps; no inferred identifier or unsupported verdict is finalized.
Declare model/extraction capabilities independently of workflow/storage providers; support configured deterministic research without an LLM and never silently substitute a model provider.
tasks.test_requirements: Structured-output failure, prompt injection, missing citations, budget exhaustion and grounded evaluation tests.

tasks.title: Implement case-scoped retrieval, semantic tools and research agents
tasks.context: Retrieval and agent tools are optional provider adapters over authorized evidence; no Snowflake trial workaround or hosted CoCo feasibility is required.
acceptance_criteria: Deploy reviewed search/semantic definitions over approved case facts and excerpts.
Enforce tenant/case authorization before retrieval and tool execution.
Return traceable citations and abstain on unsupported questions.
Record tool/cost traces and verify account/runtime compatibility without assuming entitlement.
For a single-organization installation, restrict direct Search service access and tool invocation to approved installation roles; test unauthorized account roles as well as application callers.
If multi-tenant support is enabled later, prove direct retrieval isolation separately from application filters; shared indexes must not bypass case/tenant authorization.

Select retrieval and agent tools by supported provider capabilities; web discovery remains distinct from complete verified connector responses, and model-selected tools must preserve identity and provenance gates.
tasks.test_requirements: Cross-tenant retrieval, invalid citation, unsupported question and bounded-cost live QA tests.

tasks.title: Complete approved security, residency and cost readiness
tasks.context: Provider-independent permissions, residency, quotas and cost controls are required for managed workflow use; Snowflake trial/billing troubleshooting and separately hosted backend deployment are out of scope.
acceptance_criteria: Recheck effective roles, approved managed task runtime and source-access capabilities for the selected provider profile.
Resolve/document residual inherited access and production isolation boundaries.
Approve configured model geography, allowed models and provider workflow/compute budgets; verify alert delivery.
Keep schedules suspended until readiness approval; account-wide changes require owner approval.
Provide operator-controlled preflight, start, pause and resume procedures for a self-hosted installation; automatic processing is opt-in, not enabled by setup.
Verify one bounded scheduled case, emergency suspension and recovery/rollback without losing queued cases or duplicating completed results; record explicit activation approval.
tasks.test_requirements: Positive/negative access tests, budget/alert evidence and reviewed preflight report.

tasks.title: Verify full live cases across two jurisdictions
tasks.context: Connector checks and fixture specialist tests are not an integrated live case proof.
acceptance_criteria: Run approved bounded live cases with at least three operational specialist lanes.
Verify RAW/OPS plus durable case/stage/normalized output readback and citations.
Demonstrate identity ambiguity, one source outage and replay without fresh fetching.
Record live versus captured-replay evidence and every coverage gap; never enable blocked sources to pass a demo.
tasks.test_requirements: Two-jurisdiction run, restart/replay, outage and exact evidence lineage verification.

tasks.title: Build the connected analyst intake-to-review UI
tasks.context: The UI is deliberately deferred; prototype/design are not connected product completion.
acceptance_criteria: Reuse the agreed design and authorized application services for case/review commands; a separate HTTP API deployment is optional.
Support intake, candidate confirmation, stages, comparison, citations, clarification and review history.
Display unscored/pending/blocked states honestly; protect raw personal data.
Refresh/navigation preserves case state; no UI-only decisions or synthetic live fallbacks.

Trigger approved workflows through provider-independent application services and reconnect to persisted case/run IDs after browser closure; a separate always-running HTTP backend is optional, but deployed task execution is required.

Show the DAG, parallel branches, numbered attempts, durations, sanitized errors and terminal outputs; distinguish execution success, source coverage and business assessment, and use durable workflow projections rather than unpublished legacy tables.
tasks.test_requirements: Desktop/mobile browser flow, long multilingual names, failures, stale review and authorization tests.

tasks.title: Implement incremental monitoring and idempotent notifications
tasks.context: There are no operational watchlists, monitored refreshes or notification delivery.
acceptance_criteria: Store authorized watchlists and source-specific refresh schedules with budgets.
Upstream changes create new immutable evidence/case versions, not overwrite reviews.
Use one effective outbox event per change and expose stale-source alerts.
Verify disabled subscriptions, retries and opt-out before scheduling.
tasks.test_requirements: Unchanged feed, duplicate update, process restart, failed notification and unsubscribe tests.

tasks.title: Automate CI and reproducible provider-profile installation checks
tasks.context: Reproducible setup of the selected UI, procedures/jobs and managed workflows needs verification; no separate backend-service hosting project is required.
acceptance_criteria: Add CI for locked install, tests, lint, backlog checks and secret scanning.
Verify migrations/deployment generation on clean checkout and an approved fresh environment.
Document health checks, rollback/reconciliation and recovery runbooks.
Publish no credential-containing artifacts; cloud deployment/spend require explicit approval.
tasks.test_requirements: Clean checkout, migration drift, dependency lock, secret fixtures and approved deployment smoke.

tasks.title: Reconcile current README and implementation status documents
tasks.context: Some historical documents still describe implemented specialists as missing.
acceptance_criteria: Update current-status sections against code without erasing dated historical live reports.
Link baseline and backlog; distinguish local tests, live retrieval, replay and deployed operation.
List actual opt-in specialist flags and review/validation limitations.
Record evidence dates and avoid presenting scaffolded features as live services.
tasks.test_requirements: Run documented offline commands and check all internal links/status claims.

tasks.title: Activate Companies House only after approved API access
tasks.context: The adapter is deliberately paused while API access is unavailable.
acceptance_criteria: Obtain approved API access outside the repository and store secrets securely.
Review usage rights and remove the pause only through a reviewed change.
Verify real scoped identity lookup and RAW/OPS readback with bounded requests.
Keep officers/filings/ownership expansion in separately scoped follow-up issues.
tasks.test_requirements: Credential absent/invalid, rate-limit, identifier mismatch and approved live lookup tests.

tasks.title: Resolve court computational-analysis permission
tasks.context: Court ingestion is intentionally gated and must not be bypassed.
acceptance_criteria: Document permission for the intended project use or retain blocked coverage.
Set the existing approval configuration only after actual approval.
Verify bounded metadata ingestion and permitted retention/display independently from judgment interpretation.
Record source-use restrictions and renewal/revocation handling.
tasks.test_requirements: Default block, revoked permission and approved bounded metadata integration tests.

tasks.title: Expand official legal/adverse-event sources by jurisdiction
tasks.context: Current legal coverage is mostly UK metadata and World Bank procurement; it is not worldwide legal coverage.
acceptance_criteria: Prioritize one jurisdiction/source family and create a separate child issue for each adapter before coding.
Research official access, usage rights, party identifiers, procedural labels, appeal/finality fields and coverage.
Keep each adapter independently registered; expand the specialist's supported source contracts explicitly.
Verify real retrieval, persisted provenance and negative attribution examples; document unsupported countries and records.
tasks.test_requirements: Jurisdiction-specific fixtures, access/schema failures, ambiguous parties and approved live RAW/OPS verification.

tasks.title: Implement worker health, metrics and actionable alerts
tasks.context: Sanitized source errors exist, but production health, tracing, metrics and alert delivery are incomplete.
acceptance_criteria: Expose authenticated or appropriately restricted health/readiness checks without leaking secrets.
Trace case/run/branch/source IDs and measure queue age, source latency, coverage, retries and stalled stages.
Configure approved alerts for sustained failures, stale sources, exhausted budgets and worker liveness.
Redact raw personal data and credentials; document retention, alert ownership and recovery runbooks.
tasks.test_requirements: Worker death, stalled case, source outage, alert deduplication, unauthorized metrics and redaction tests.

tasks.title: Decide open-source release scope and record architecture decisions
tasks.context: The hackathon scope is closed. A maintained worldwide open-source solution needs explicit first-release boundaries rather than inherited demo assumptions.
acceptance_criteria: Record the 2026-10-04 direction change; remove hackathon submission and deadline obligations from active plans while preserving dated history.
Decide first use cases, entity types, supported jurisdictions, non-goals and release acceptance; worldwide intent does not imply worldwide coverage.
Create dated decision records with rationale, alternatives, owner, affected issues and supersession for identity, review authority, scoring, hosting and model choices.
Map every retained thought to an issue or an explicitly deferred decision; resolve provider/news/notification choices in their existing tasks rather than duplicate implementation.

Maintain a tested thought-to-task coverage map; the 2026-10-05 scope is provider-portable Streamlit with managed procedures/jobs and DAG workflows. Hackathon, trial-account workarounds and separately hosted backend deployment are excluded; preserve historical reports without treating them as active requirements.
tasks.test_requirements: Review the scope and traceability matrix with maintainers; verify every unresolved decision has an owning task and no historical demo default is represented as an approved production choice.

tasks.title: Establish open-source licensing, contribution and maintenance policies
tasks.context: A public repository alone does not grant an open-source license or establish sustainable maintenance; no license choice is assumed.
acceptance_criteria: Obtain maintainer approval for a code license and add LICENSE, notices and package metadata; distinguish code licensing from source-data rights.
Publish contribution, conduct, governance and private vulnerability-reporting policies; identify maintainer and review responsibilities without inventing contacts or response promises.
Define release versioning, support/deprecation policy, changelog and dependency update ownership; track SBOM/dependency/license checks with TS-029.
Provide rights-safe examples and a documented first-contribution path; never redistribute raw personal data or licensed source datasets by default.
tasks.test_requirements: Check license/metadata consistency, documentation links, contributor clean-checkout workflow and dependency/data redistribution review.

tasks.title: Version component contracts and verify adapter compatibility
tasks.context: Portable boundaries exist, but compatibility and independent reuse must be tested before replacing stores, workflows or models.
acceptance_criteria: Inventory connector, store, runtime, specialist, aggregator, validation, assessment, review and AI interfaces with versioned schemas and capability declarations.
Define backward-reading, migration and unsupported-version behavior for observations, findings, snapshots, graph definitions and review decisions.
Create reusable adapter conformance tests and independent component examples; keep cloud SDKs and SQL out of domain contracts.
Define plugin discovery/configuration allowlists and compatibility/deprecation rules; do not execute untrusted downloaded plugins automatically.

Define a versioned provider-neutral DAG/task specification for dependencies, identity gates, fan-out/join, Python and SQL stages, retries, timeouts and output references; reject cycles and unsupported native capabilities.

Separate application services from transport so Streamlit can call authorized commands directly or through an optional API; do not require a separately deployed microservice for every reusable component.
tasks.test_requirements: Run conforming and deliberately nonconforming adapters, old-snapshot replay, schema upgrade and unavailable-capability tests.

tasks.title: Implement safe fork-and-install onboarding and environment diagnostics
tasks.context: A contributor should fork, configure approved services and install without chat history; the proposed onboarding commands are not already implemented.
acceptance_criteria: Provide doctor -> plan -> apply -> smoke-test -> deploy-ui stages or equivalent documented commands, keeping UI deployment deferred to TS-027.
Separate UI hosting, durable worker execution, evidence storage and local installation commands; validate account/region/features, identities, network access and estimated spend.
Make planning non-mutating, application explicitly approved, repeated installation safe, and partial failure/upgrade reconciliation documented; never overwrite operator credentials.
Verify clean-install, upgrade and unavailable-capability paths for supported providers; report requirements honestly and document uninstall/data-preservation choices.

Keep .env.example as the shareable template and private configuration as credential references; distinguish human installer login, workload credentials or managed identity, and supplied in-platform sessions without exporting secrets to browsers.

Diagnose billing, API enablement, quotas, runtime packages, SQL resources, permissions and outbound source access before installation; credentials alone cannot make a profile ready, and task schedules remain inactive until approved.
tasks.test_requirements: Test absent credentials, unsupported capability, dry run, duplicate install, partial DDL and upgrade; record approved fresh-account smoke/readback separately from fixtures.

tasks.title: Implement provider-neutral workflow, storage and model adapter boundaries
tasks.context: Target architecture is provider-portable; Snowflake is an existing adapter, not a required platform. Candidate cloud profiles require bounded implementation and verification before support claims.
acceptance_criteria: Publish a capability matrix and runtime/storage/model/secrets adapter interfaces, preserving durable case ownership and raw-evidence verification.
Select one alternative provider from actual demand and create bounded child issues for runtime, persistence, identity, secrets, deployment and AI capabilities before coding.
Keep Streamlit the sole user-facing surface; do not force a separate microservice per component or silently substitute providers.
Require full contract and live install/restart/replay verification before marking a provider supported; identify region/cost/source-access constraints.

Retain candidate profiles explicitly: Snowflake Tasks/procedures, Google Workflows/Cloud Run Jobs with optional Dataproc or Composer, AWS Step Functions/functions or container jobs, and Azure Durable Functions/activities; Dataproc/Spark is optional batch compute, not the execution engine for every connector.

Translate the shared graph into one native execution owner per run; keep provider SDKs and SQL dialects behind adapters, avoid nested competing orchestrators, and use explicit operational-state, evidence-object and analytical-storage adapters.
Evaluate authenticated Streamlit-to-workflow connectivity for complete single-provider profiles; hybrid installations are opt-in and no component is silently moved across providers.

Normalize native engine states and events into case/run/stage/attempt contracts with correlation IDs and output references; reconcile engine success separately from business assessment and evidence coverage.

Choose supported transactional guarantees for operational state separately from object evidence and analytical SQL; document dialect, package and transaction differences instead of treating warehouses as interchangeable databases.

Specify rights-safe provider migration of evidence, case versions and reviewer history with stable IDs/hash verification; a new customer installation must not reuse another customer's secrets or silently lose prior audit data.
tasks.test_requirements: Review the matrix and child issues; test unsupported-provider rejection and conformance; verify one approved alternate profile end to end before support claims.

tasks.title: Implement approved evidence retention, redaction and deletion lifecycle
tasks.context: Restricted raw responses may contain personal information. Immutable review history is not permission for indefinite retention.
acceptance_criteria: Obtain operator-approved jurisdiction/source/purpose policies for raw documents, extracts, search indexes, case snapshots, audit and logs; record license renewal/revocation.
Implement restricted correction/access/deletion workflows and lawful hold handling with identity verification and minimal non-sensitive audit references.
Propagate permitted purge/redaction across caches, indexes, exports and backup lifecycle; document erasure limits and recompute/invalidate affected assessments.
Test retention enforcement and restore behavior; do not infer legal requirements from a generic default or alter live retention without approval.
tasks.test_requirements: Test expiry, revocation, authorized/unauthorized requests, legal hold, indexed copies and restore-after-deletion; record privacy-owner approval.

tasks.title: Define disaster recovery targets and verify backup restoration
tasks.context: Interrupted-source retries do not recover a lost installation or complete evidence/decision history.
acceptance_criteria: Agree RPO/RTO and failure scenarios for each supported deployment profile; distinguish prototype exports from production recovery promises.
Back up evidence lineage, run/checkpoint state, graph/model/policy versions and review/outbox records using permitted rights/residency boundaries.
Implement documented restore/reconciliation procedures that avoid duplicate notifications, stale scores and resurrected deleted content.
Run an approved isolated restore drill with integrity/readback checks; evaluate Snowflake recovery features only against actual edition, region and budget.
tasks.test_requirements: Restore representative cases and decisions into an isolated environment, check hashes/history, reconcile pending work and measure achieved recovery targets.

tasks.title: Threat-model source, agent, plugin and deployment boundaries
tasks.context: Existing authorization and Cortex injection tasks need a cross-component threat model, not a second implementation of the same safeguards.
acceptance_criteria: Document trust boundaries, abuse cases and ownership covering retrieval, document parsing, agent tools, plugins, exports and installation.
Add bounded tests for SSRF/redirect host escape, malformed/compressed documents, SQL injection, secret leakage and unsafe tool invocation; link TS-023 prompt-injection tests.
Define least-privilege service identities, secret rotation and compromised-key response; separate tenant/user credentials from account administration.
Link mitigations and accepted residual risks to release gates and private disclosure processes in TS-036; no intrusive live testing without approval.
tasks.test_requirements: Run adversarial fixtures and authorization/secret checks; review residual risks and approved incident tabletop outcomes.

tasks.title: Define service targets, quotas and durable cancellation semantics
tasks.context: Global monitoring needs measured source freshness and bounded resource consumption, not an unconditional real-time promise.
acceptance_criteria: Choose source-specific freshness/latency/availability targets, alert ownership and incident response procedures; distinguish provider delay from system delay.
Enforce per-case/source/tenant quotas, admission control and fair bounded concurrency for ingestion, inference and monitoring; account cost monitors are not complete spend caps.
Implement authorized cancel/resume semantics that stop new work, preserve persisted evidence and reconcile in-flight writes without duplicate case owners.
Verify overload, queue saturation, budget exhaustion and cancellation during fetch/write/aggregation; connect approved alerts through TS-034 and notifications through TS-028.
tasks.test_requirements: Run bounded load/soak and fault tests, verify quota isolation and cancellation races; record measured targets rather than unsupported SLO claims.

tasks.title: Scope official financial filings and disclosure research
tasks.context: Financial statements, restatements and overdue filings are preserved target dimensions but not approved source-specific implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Decide supported issuer/entity types and one official jurisdiction/source family, researching rights and identifier coverage before selecting an adapter.
Create bounded connector and specialist child issues for permitted filings, restatements and filing status with period/currency/accounting-context contracts.
Preserve reported facts and corrections with raw lineage; do not infer fraud, insolvency or universal solvency from ratios or absent filings.
Define applicability and labeled attribution/interpretation tests; unsupported private-company records remain not_applicable or coverage gaps as appropriate.
tasks.test_requirements: Review source terms and child-task scope; require period/unit, restatement, same-name, missing-record and approved live provenance tests before implementation acceptance.

tasks.title: Scope official product, safety and cyber-event research
tasks.context: Recalls, safety actions, closures and material cyber events remain a logical specialist dimension; news presence alone does not verify such an event.
acceptance_criteria: Choose one official source family and jurisdiction and publish separately scoped adapter/specialist child issues after access and rights review.
Define subject/manufacturer/operator/product/affected-party roles and event states with dates, revisions and source evidence.
Distinguish reported incidents, regulator notices, remediation and final findings; do not infer party blame or automatic risk scores.
Evaluate entity/product ambiguity, corrections and incomplete source coverage; avoid collecting sensitive breach victim data.
tasks.test_requirements: Review the event taxonomy and child issues; require negative attribution, revision and approved live evidence/readback tests.

tasks.title: Decide and scope contextual business conflict-of-interest research
tasks.context: Conflicting source claims, sanctions relationships and business conflicts of interest are separate concepts. A shared director is not proof of wrongdoing.
acceptance_criteria: Decide whether procurement/employment/business conflict checks belong in the supported product and explicitly defer them if no approved use case exists.
Define input context, independently resolved people/organizations, dated relationship evidence and approved relevance rules.
Create bounded implementation/evaluation child issues only after policy approval; label potential relationships and uncertainty, never automatic wrongdoing.
Preserve personal-data restrictions and human review; do not repurpose public role data beyond approved purpose/rights.
tasks.test_requirements: Review use-case decision, positive/negative same-name/shared-director cases, time-bound relationships and privacy limits.

tasks.title: Specify accessible and localized Streamlit review workflows
tasks.context: UI remains later. Multilingual entity matching does not establish an accessible localized analyst interface.
acceptance_criteria: Extend the agreed Streamlit experience with keyboard/focus/screen-reader, contrast, status announcements and non-color-only evidence states.
Define locale/date/time-zone and original-language evidence display; preserve original names and distinguish translations from source text.
Verify long names, right-to-left/multiscript content where supported, desktop/mobile layout and error recovery without losing durable case state.
Document the supported accessibility/localization test matrix and unmet limitations; avoid introducing a second user-facing frontend.
tasks.test_requirements: Run accessibility checks and representative keyboard/screen-reader and locale tests alongside TS-027 end-to-end verification.

tasks.title: Decide release packaging and optional Snowflake Native App distribution
tasks.context: Open-source distribution needs a reproducible supported package; Snowflake Native App packaging is a future option, not a requirement inherited from the hackathon.
acceptance_criteria: Choose supported Python/container/source installation artifacts and versioning; publish compatibility, upgrade and release verification requirements.
Verify built artifacts include required SQL/config/templates without credentials, evidence outputs or locally dependent paths.
Decide whether customer Snowflake Native App delivery is needed; create feasibility and packaging child issues only if approved.
Document support boundaries, signing/provenance and dependency/SBOM checks with TS-029; no marketplace submission or paid infrastructure without approval.
tasks.test_requirements: Test artifact install from a clean environment, resources availability and upgrade; record the Native App decision and any capability/security feasibility evidence.

tasks.title: Scope external integrations and portable case evidence exports
tasks.context: External APIs, customer systems and export reuse are future integration boundaries; internal review endpoints are not a complete public integration contract.
acceptance_criteria: Select first consumer/use case; version authenticated case/evidence export and webhook contracts with pagination, idempotency and scoped permissions.
Export provenance, coverage, policy/version and review context only where rights permit; never package restricted raw documents or personal identifiers by default.
Define signed delivery/retry/replay, key rotation, opt-out, size limits and audit records; reuse TS-022/028 outbox rather than a second notification engine.
Document compatibility and implement one bounded integration child issue; no CRM/ERP breadth or compliance guarantees implied.
tasks.test_requirements: Test tampering, cross-tenant export, revoked rights, duplicate/reordered delivery and safe large-result pagination.

tasks.title: Govern source coverage, licensing changes and connector deprecation
tasks.context: A worldwide open-source catalog needs explicit coverage and maintenance, not a list interpreted as complete jurisdiction support.
acceptance_criteria: Version country/entity/event coverage, source authority, access/rights, permitted retention/display, freshness, owner and live verification date.
Define source approval, disabling, license revocation, schema change and deprecation procedures with affected-case/assessment invalidation.
Publish contributor adapter checklists and rights-safe fixture requirements; link TS-010/031/032/033 expansion and access gates.
Distinguish no_matches, no coverage, blocked access, stale snapshot and failure; unsupported countries remain explicit and cannot receive a clean score.
tasks.test_requirements: Test schema/terms changes, revoked source and stale catalog, verify impacted-case handling and review one new-source proposal without bypassing access.

tasks.title: Scope installation and tenant lifecycle administration
tasks.context: Self-hosted installations are the current direction; a hosted customer control plane with BYO cloud credentials remains optional and unimplemented.
acceptance_criteria: Decide single-installation versus hosted multi-tenant support and document ownership of identities, service credentials, data residency and quotas.
For approved hosted scope, create bounded child issues for membership invitation/revocation, case ownership, offboarding and tenant-bound secret/pool isolation.
Never accept arbitrary customer cloud credentials through a public endpoint or store all customer secrets in one shared dotenv file.
Verify tenant offboarding and installation removal retain/delete data according to approved policy; hosted billing/control-plane features stay deferred unless requested.
tasks.test_requirements: Review hosting decision and child tasks; require revoked membership, tenant deletion, connection isolation and secret rotation tests for any supported hosted profile.

direction.active_scope: Provider-portable worldwide open-source research solution; Streamlit UI and provider-managed procedures/jobs/DAG workflows.
direction.hackathon_scope: Closed; no submission, deadline or CoCo proof obligation.
excluded_scope: Snowflake trial-account workaround and upgrade investigations
Separately hosted always-running backend service as a required architecture

scope_coverage.basis: Visible conversation, current repository scope and published issues; not a guarantee about unseen discussions.
